name: Madrasso
description: Madrasso is a classic Venetian trick-taking game played in partnerships. It is a member of the 'Tressette' family but features a trump suit, making it a bridge between Tressette and Briscola. Known for its specific point target (777 points) and the 'exchange' of the trump indicator card, it is the quintessential game of the Veneto region of Italy. It requires careful hand management and a strong memory of point-cards already played.

content.text: Madrasso is a classic Venetian trick-taking game played in partnerships. It is a member of the 'Tressette' family but features a trump suit, making it a bridge between Tressette and Briscola. Known for its specific point target (777 points) and the 'exchange' of the trump indicator card, it is the quintessential game of the Veneto region of Italy. It requires careful hand management and a strong memory of point-cards already played.
Developed in the 18th century as a variation of Tressette that introduced the 'Atout' (Trump) as a permanent feature.
4 players in two partnerships (North-South vs East-West).
40 cards: Ace (11), 3 (10), King (4), Knight (3), Jack (2), and 7-6-5-4-2 (0). Total points = 120 + 10 for last trick.
Each player is dealt 10 cards. The 21st card is turned face-up as the Trump Indicator.

items.text: Madrasso a Tre: A 3-player version with a dummy or discarded cards.
Tressette con Biliardo: A related regional trick-taker.
Briscola Chiamata: The broader 'called trump' family.
